## Assistant (final)

I checked the repo: shadcn is not installed in this checkout yet. The frontend at [frontend/package.json](/Users/neiloler/dev/webhook-demo/frontend/package.json) has no Tailwind/shadcn deps, and `npx shadcn@latest info -c frontend` reports `tailwindVersion: null` and no `components.json`.

What we need to do:

1. Target the actual Next app, not the repo root:

```sh
npx shadcn@latest init --preset b2C6zavXk --template next --pointer -c frontend
```

2. Add Tailwind v4 support to `frontend/` if the init does not do it cleanly:
   - install `tailwindcss`, `@tailwindcss/postcss`, `postcss`
   - add `frontend/postcss.config.mjs`
   - add `@import "tailwindcss";` at the top of [frontend/app/globals.css](/Users/neiloler/dev/webhook-demo/frontend/app/globals.css)

3. Expect shadcn to create/update:
   - `frontend/components.json`
   - `frontend/lib/utils.ts`
   - `frontend/components/ui/*`
   - theme variables in `frontend/app/globals.css`
   - dependencies such as `clsx`, `tailwind-merge`, `class-variance-authority`, and whatever the preset’s icon setup needs

4. Add only the components we actually need, for example:

```sh
npx shadcn@latest add button card input label badge -c frontend
```

5. Clean up the current global CSS over time. Right now [globals.css](/Users/neiloler/dev/webhook-demo/frontend/app/globals.css) styles raw `button`, `input`, and `label` elements globally, which can fight with shadcn components. Best path: add shadcn first, then migrate the page UI to shadcn/Tailwind and remove or scope the old element selectors.

Your preset decodes to: `maia` style, `emerald` theme, `stone` base color, `inter` font, and `hugeicons` icons. The shadcn docs confirm `-c/--cwd`, `--pointer`, presets, and `preset decode`; Tailwind’s current Next guide uses Tailwind v4 with `@tailwindcss/postcss` and `@import "tailwindcss"`.

Sources: [shadcn CLI docs](https://ui.shadcn.com/docs/cli), [shadcn Next docs](https://ui.shadcn.com/docs/installation/next), [Tailwind Next docs](https://tailwindcss.com/docs/guides/nextjs).
